description: Source code for the SocketBIOAdapter class, which provides an OpenSSL BIO interface for socket I/O, used internally in Chromium's net code to facilitate TLS connections.

classes.name: SocketBIOAdapter
classes.description: Implements an OpenSSL BIO interface for socket communication, managing asynchronous reads and writes, buffering, and error handling.

methods.name: BIORead
methods.description: Reads data from the socket via the BIO interface, handling buffering and asynchronous read completion.

methods.name: BIOWrite
methods.description: Writes data to the socket via the BIO interface, managing buffering and asynchronous write completion.

methods.name: HandleSocketReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a socket read operation, updating internal state.

methods.name: HandleSocketWriteResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a socket write operation, updating internal buffers and state.

methods.name: OnSocketReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when an asynchronous socket read completes.

methods.name: OnSocketReadIfReadyComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when a socket read-if-ready operation completes.

methods.name: OnSocketWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked when an asynchronous socket write completes.

methods.name: CallOnReadReady
methods.description: Signals that the socket is ready for reading.

methods.name: GetAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the SocketBIOAdapter instance from a BIO pointer.

methods.name: BIOWriteWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIOWrite, used by OpenSSL.

methods.name: BIOReadWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIORead, used by OpenSSL.

methods.name: BIOCtrlWrapper
methods.description: Static wrapper for BIO control commands, e.g., flush.
